name: WOODSTOVE
tagline: Cast iron. Always on. Please do not touch the front.
description: A boxy wood-burning stove drawn in thick black outline on cream paper, standing on two short blocky legs. The body is a rough square, slightly wider than tall. In its centre sits a small square window showing a fire, filled with red flame and an orange flame on the right, crossed by 4 vertical black bars. A single narrow rectangular chimney pipe rises from the top centre. Out of the chimney drift 3 loopy smoke puffs in black line, getting bigger and looser as they curl up and to the upper left, the last one a tangled scribble with a wisp trailing off. The legs are asymmetric: the left leg ends in a foot pointing left, the right leg ends in a longer foot pointing right that sits a little lower. Only the fire is coloured.
card: ATTACK  Flame licks out the door
GRAB  Stuff them in, fire out chimney
